info.name: Hours on client work

kpis.label: Average margin after overhead

info.name: Average margin after overhead
info.definition: The margin after overhead of the projects far enough along to judge (fee earned less hours at cost, overhead and direct costs), weighted by the fee each earned in the period. The fee used, beside it, leaves the overhead out. Judged against its own target (Control panel → Insights targets), not the net margin’s.
info.formula: Σ (fee earned − cost) ÷ Σ fee earned, judged projects

kpis.sub: 3 of 3 projects far enough along to judge

kpis.label: Over their fee

info.name: Over their fee
info.definition: Projects whose fee used to date -- hours at cost and direct costs, without overhead -- is above their fee.
info.formula: count of projects with labour at cost + direct costs to date > fee
info.period: As at the end of the period: today for the current one, the closed month's snapshot for a past one.

kpis.sub: Cost to date above the fee

kpis.label: Burning ahead of time

info.name: Burning ahead of time
info.definition: Projects using their fee (hours at cost and direct costs, without overhead; or, without a fee, their estimate) faster than their time passes, by more than the margin set in Settings.
info.formula: fee (or estimate) used % > time elapsed % + margin
info.period: As at the end of the period: today for the current one, the closed month's snapshot for a past one.
